source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Three entire aromatic gland-dotted elliptic-lanceolate leaflets
morphology_documented.flowers: Terminal panicles of small greenish yellow 4–5-petaled mostly functionally unisexual flowers
morphology_documented.fruit: Thin circular winged samara 22–28 mm across (key)
morphology_documented.habitat: Rocky hillsides, sandy and stream woods

source_scope_note: Historical rank and source scope retained; genus, species, variety and comparator traits not conflated.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora separates historical glabrate large-gland subsp. angustifolia var. persicifolia from hairy small-gland subsp. trifoliata var. mollis; infraspecific taxa intergrade
preservation: Additive research only; original species, images, credits and galleries untouched
